summary: Ann Arbor, Michigan, business professional with a background in management and executive leadership, strong interest in college athletics, particularly University of Michigan football, advocate for student-athlete welfare and integrity in sports, member and former board member of the Inter-Cooperative Council in Ann Arbor, critical of sensationalist sports media and bloggers, values education and ethical leadership in sports, engaged in discussions about social and political issues, particularly regarding community responsibility and the impact of corporate behavior.
